description: An ADSR envelope generator that can also cycle on its own, with the envelope and its inverse on separate jacks

params.text: Sets how long the envelope takes to climb to full, 1ms to 5 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from full to the sustain level, up to 5 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds at while the gate is high, from nothing to full
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall back to nothing after the gate goes low, up to 5 seconds
Starts the envelope again each time its decay finishes, and while it is on the Trig input is not read at all

inputs.text: Starts the envelope on a rising edge above 1V and releases it once the voltage falls back to 1V or below
Adds to the attack time at one second per volt, and the total is held at 1ms at the shortest
Adds to the decay time at one second per volt
Adds to the sustain level, 1V covering the whole of the S knob, and nothing clamps the total
Adds to the release time at one second per volt

outputs.text: The envelope turned upside down, 10V while the envelope is at rest and 0V while it is at full

notes: nothing comes out until either a trigger reaches Trig or Cycle is switched on; with neither, the envelope never starts

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V, which holds the envelope released; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V, so the knob alone; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
